title: Restore a robot vacuum whose main brush was misseated after cleaning
instruction: Restore the robot vacuum’s main brush and cover so it is ready to clean.
setup: CONTACT PROTOTYPE. Source reconstructed full-scale S7 robot and real brush mechanism, on a folded service towel.
fidelity: Source-reconstructed full-scale rigid shell, roller with rubber vane geometry, physical keyed socket, four cover hooks and spring slider catches. Powered off. Rubber and cloth compliance approximated as rigid.
